facts.fact: Roop and Chand are the last crew pair to cross back from Ranu, bound to each other until the thaw. Roop carries Kiran's note.
facts.why: needed because the outline calls for 'the last crew pair to cross back' to deliver the note, and they need names to speak.

facts.fact: Jassi names his pack goats Pomegranate, Auntie, Sheriff, Magistrate and Judge.
facts.why: needed because the outline has Jassi naming every goat.

facts.fact: Wardens make a sweep of Kothi Shilak every tenth day, so Meera expected a patrol on the day Rohan arrives.
facts.why: needed to give Meera's goal (leave before the wardens arrive) a reason to be on a deadline.

facts.fact: The brass button left as the token for the next drop is small, domed, plain and brand new with a stiff shank. The next courier is to carry its twin, and without the twin no crate is released.
facts.why: needed to define the C21 token concretely so the later match to Varun's new coat button (ch 2) is fair.

facts.fact: Kiran's note gives Nimmi's tally as forty-one sick, nine of them under ten, and six buried.
facts.why: needed because the outline calls for Nimmi's tally of the sick.

facts.fact: The Closing Law notice is nailed to the left gatepost of Kothi Shilak, and the hanging tree is a deodar just outside the gate with one peg hammered into the trunk per hanging. Two pegs are pale from last winter.
facts.why: needed for the gate scene with the notice and the hanging tree.

facts.fact: Meera, with Bindu's help, hides the redbark in the middle of one of Bindu's raw wool bales. They have rehearsed this for four winters.
facts.why: needed because the outline has Meera hide the redbark in Bindu's wool bales.
